body:
**Verification:** Production testing is done. Smoke tested the Email is Bounced in Saleshandy (Pipedrive) trigger on Production with the smoke script, all 11 checks:

| # | Activity | What was checked | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Create a Lead, Create a Deal and Create a Person in Pipedrive | New prospect, step 1 email marked as bounced. One person with one lead and one deal titled with the prospect email, and one activity. | Pass |
| 2 | Create a Person in Pipedrive | Existing person with an old value in a mapped field. Still one person, and an activity is added. | Pass |
| 3 | Update a Person in Pipedrive | Existing person with an old value in a mapped field. Mapped fields are updated and one activity is added. | Pass |
| 4 | Update a Deal in Pipedrive | Person with 2 deals. Only the newest deal changes (title is the prospect email, Pipeline / Contact Made). The older deal is unchanged. | Pass |
| 5 | Delete Deal in Pipedrive | Person with 2 deals. Only the newest deal is deleted. The older deal stays. | Pass |
| 6 | Delete Person in Pipedrive | Existing person is deleted. | Pass |
| 7 | Create Organization in Pipedrive | Company with no organization of that name. One organization is created with the mapped fields, not linked to any person or deal. | Pass |
| 8 | Update Organization in Pipedrive | Organization with the exact company name and an old mapped value. Still one organization, mapped value updated. | Pass |
| 9 | Delete Organization in Pipedrive | Organization with the exact company name is deleted. | Pass |
| 10 | Only "Reply is Received in Saleshandy" enabled | Bounce creates no person in Pipedrive. | Pass |
| 11 | Create a Person in Pipedrive (real bounce) | Real-bounce address, Send now on step 1. The Emails tab shows Bounced, with one person and one activity (type email, done, subject "Email is bounced in Saleshandy"). | Pass |
waitingFor: QA to check the wording and send. Source: smoke script run by QA on 2026-10-29, account emailopenedprod, Pipedrive saleshandy.pipedrive.com, sequence 985126. First run: 9 of 11 passed (checks 1 and 4 failed). Rerun of checks 1 and 4 with new test data: both passed.
